title: Dispatch | OpenAI Confirms $200/Month ChatGPT Pro — Unlimited Access Including Full o1
summary: OpenAI confirmed rumors: ChatGPT Pro at $200/month — unlimited access to all OpenAI models, including the full o1 “reasoning” model. Tech team member Jason Wei on a Thursday livestream: Pro targets power users already pushing models to the limit on math, coding, and writing.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Dispatch · December 6, 2024

OpenAI confirmed rumors: ChatGPT Pro at $200/month — unlimited access to all OpenAI models, including the full o1 “reasoning” model. Tech team member Jason Wei on a Thursday livestream: Pro targets power users already pushing models to the limit on math, coding, and writing.

Unlike most AI, o1 and peer reasoners try to self-check — fewer classic traps, longer time to answer. o1 plans tasks and runs steps that help derive answers. September’s o1 preview is now generally stronger: “faster, more powerful, more accurate — better at coding and math,” a spokesperson told TechCrunch. New: reason over uploaded images; trained to “think more concisely” for latency. Internal tests: 34% fewer “major errors” on hard real-world problems vs. preview. Oddly, full o1 still trails preview on some benchmarks (e.g., MLE-Bench for ML-engineering agents).

o1 is available without Pro — all paid ChatGPT users get o1 via the model picker from this afternoon. Pro adds o1 pro mode: “more compute for the hardest questions.” Select it in the picker; progress bar while generating; in-app notify if you switch chats. May simply lengthen reasoning time — OpenAI has said it wants o1 variants that reason for hours, days, even weeks.

External expert testers: o1 pro mode more accurate and comprehensive in data science, coding, case-law analysis; stronger on hard ML benchmarks in math/science/coding vs. o1 and preview — 75% lower error rate on easier coding-contest problems (closer to everyday queries). o1 hits the API soon with function calling and image analysis; web browsing and file upload planned in coming months.

Pro is OpenAI’s priciest plan yet — 10× ChatGPT Plus — likely limited to the most loyal users who already find Plus steep. Sweetener: unlimited GPT-4o and Advanced Voice Mode. OpenAI will gift 10 Pro seats to medical researchers at “top institutions,” with more gifts across disciplines later.

Price hikes were rumored: NYT reported Plus possibly $44/mo by 2029; The Information said OpenAI eyed ultra-premium commercial tiers. Aggressive moves reflect investor pressure to shrink losses — NYT: ~$300M monthly revenue in August but ~$5B loss expected this year (comp, rent, training infra). ChatGPT once reportedly cost ~$700k/day. ChatGPT remains a top revenue line: 300M+ weekly actives, ~10M paid.

— END —
